ab: You earned the right to be called Chief of your Herd and with this responsibility you become more powerful before a fight. 10% attack damage and 5% increase to Stamina Regeneration when out of combat

Applies 1 stack of Discombobulated to Punch, Haymaker and Back Kick.
After 5 stack is activates concussion.
Concussion increase turn in place speed by 1.5x and decrease attack damage by 15% and movement speed by 75%
Cerataspida are known to use their horns as a weapon when fighting predators. Medium damage (55 DMG)
Able to eat berries and fruit, moderate food drain.
Cerataspida does a series of small hits with their front hooves that can easily make any predator regret their actions. Medium damage (60 DMG).
When crouching you move faster and have a tighter turn radius
Take no extra damage from head attacks.
With the power of the spirits you gain the healing powers to recover from battle. 10% increases to health recovery
With the power of the ancient warriors you gain strength but take more damage. 5% increase to attack damage
Cerata are can deliver a powerful back kick that can easily knockout predators. High damage (80 DMG), does knockback and adds to the Dazed stack. Can only be used while crouched
A quick attack thats stacks with each hit. Can stack up to 5. Low damage (10 DMG per punch)

Cerataspida are known to taunt predator to make them more aggressive but lowers its defense. Increases the attack damage and incoming damage by 20% to the nearest player, only works on people out of group

Tremor smash, Back kick, and Bludgeon Barrage attacks now apply 'Dazed' for 3 seconds.
While Dazed, targets have reduced movement speed by 5% and can't use active abilities. Targets can only be Dazed every 40 seconds.
Able to eat flowers, nuts, roots, and fruit. Faster food drain.
Cerataspida are known to launch forwards at predators to deliver a massive punch to opponents and knock them out. High damage (150 AP DMG)

Cerataspida are often known to be leaders of a group of herbivores when they go on migrations. Increase attack damage by 2.5% for every herbivore in your group, stacks up to 5. Large herbivores dont activate the buff

Cerataspida give an aura of safety when its around that herbivores feel they can relax and save energy. Increases movement speed and decreases incoming damage by 20% but also lowers attack damage by 30%. only works in groups and only affects smaller herbivores
10% amor increase and Increased Maneuverability when not in group

When in raged cerataspida are known to pound their fist together to help them prepare for a fight, 20% increase to attack damage, 15% decrease to incoming damage and 0.25 seconds off on all cooldowns for 25 seconds
Increases bleed and venom healing by 20%.
Area of Effect Attacks now have 25% increased range. Area of Effect attacks deal 50% reduced damage to group members.
Take 60% less knockback and 15% increased bone break healing.
Cerataspida will use its tail to attack predators that chase after it. Low damage (15 DMG) and knockback
Cerataspida are known to do a series of punches to the ground to disorient opponents. High damage (20 DMG for every hit to the ground) AOE, can only be used while standing still
